keyquorum.name: KeyQuorum
keyquorum.description: KeyQuorum is a secure file-sharing system centered on hardware key sharing. Files are encrypted and bound to registered physical tokens, such as USB devices. Access requires the necessary hardware keys to be presented before a protected file can be unlocked, providing layered, hardware-backed access control.

generatedTimelineEvents.title: Harden relay merge, URL, and store integrity from review
generatedTimelineEvents.detail: * **New Features** * Added hosted mailbox relay support for securely pushing and pulling encrypted envelopes. * Added public split-tree publishing, fetching, merging, and personalized topology views. * Added API-key management, validation, expiration, scopes, revocation, and rotation.

generatedTimelineEvents.title: Add Axum mailbox relay with API keys and Swagger
generatedTimelineEvents.detail: Closes part of #10: the online mailbox that keeps `.kqpb` envelopes current for every affected store.

generatedTimelineEvents.title: Add keyquorum CLI binary
generatedTimelineEvents.detail: Wraps the existing vault, locked_files, and sharing library APIs behind a clap-based command line: vault add/get, lock/unlock, and share create/redeem/revoke. Passwords are always prompted for interactively rather than accepted as arguments, keeping secrets out of shell history and process listings.

generatedTimelineEvents.title: Add PIN unlock window and `pin relock` CLI; tighten CLI validation and secure export writes
generatedTimelineEvents.detail: - Provide a cached one-time PIN verification window to avoid repeated prompts for short-lived operations. - Allow callers to explicitly end the cached PIN window via a CLI command. - Improve CLI argument validation for mode-specific options and numeric limits to prevent misuse.

generatedTimelineEvents.title: Add local SQLite schema for hardware-key-quorum storage
generatedTimelineEvents.detail: * **New Features** * Added secure password-based encryption for files and stored credentials. * Added local storage for protected files, credentials, hardware keys, sharing links, and audit events. * Added password-protected file locking and unlocking with tamper detection.

generatedTimelineEvents.detail: - Provide a mobile-first, static React/TypeScript MVP for a browser-based quantum circuit playground with an in-browser state-vector simulator and a QPU AST compiler. - Offer starter examples and a simple UI to compose, run, step, reset, and measure circuits in the browser.
